name: discovibe
description: DiscoVibe — a tiling multi-session terminal for macOS. Equidistant panes across every display, per-pane colors with always-legible text, tile themes, voice mode, quick commands, collapsible panes, saved layouts, and an attention bell that flashes + chimes when a tool is waiting on you.
author: Monica Colgan

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DiscoVibe uses the microphone for voice mode, letting you speak commands into the focused terminal.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DiscoVibe uses speech recognition to turn your spoken words into terminal commands.
